question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A small island
solution:
The correct answer is **"Islet**". (बहुत छोटा द्वीप, उपद्वीप) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the implication of the correct word:
 
• **Islet**__: a **small island**.
 __
 
• Example: *All of the offshore **islets** are stony and desolate.*
 
• Example: *The core group's numerous **islets **are extremely fertile.*
 
 
 
• It is apparent from the above explanation that **"****Islet"** is an** appropriate ****one-word substitute** for "**A small island"**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: ***Islet***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
